knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({
  library(haven)
  library(dplyr)
})

base_dir <- rprojroot::find_root(
  rprojroot::has_dir("AD_CR_HRS"),
  path = here::here()
)
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "AD_CR_HRS")
hrs_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "HRS", "Phenotype")
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data")

stopifnot(dir.exists(hrs_dir))
if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```

# Get Phenotype Information

```{r read_pheno}
pheno_df <- haven::read_sas(
  file.path(hrs_dir, "RAND_longitudinal", "randhrs1992_2022v1.sas7bdat")
) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "HHID",
    "PN",
    "RAGENDER",
    "RARACEM",
    "RAHISPAN",
    "RABYEAR",
    "RABMONTH",
    "R13AGEY_E",
    "RAEDUC",
    "RAEDYRS",
    "R13SMOKEV",
    "R13SMOKEN"
  )
```

# Get Dementia Status

```{r read_dementia}
dem_df <- haven::read_dta(
  file.path(hrs_dir, "HCAP", "LangaWeir2022v1", "cogfinalimp_9522wide.dta")
) %>%
  dplyr::select(HHID = "hhid", PN = "pn", "cogfunction2016", "cogfunction2022")
```

# Get APOE Status

```{r read_apoe}
apoe_df <- haven::read_dta(
  file.path(hrs_dir, "APOE", "apoe_serotonin_release.dta")
) %>%
  dplyr::select(HHID = "hhid", PN = "pn", APOE = "apoe") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    APOE4 = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(.data$APOE) ~ NA_real_,
      .data$APOE == 44 ~ 2,
      .data$APOE %in% c(24, 34, 42, 43) ~ 1,
      .data$APOE %in% c(22, 23, 32, 33) ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )
```

# Get Linkage File

```{r read_linkage}
linkage_df <- haven::read_sas(
  file.path(hrs_dir, "Linkage-file", "niagads_id_crosswalk.sas7bdat")
)
```

# Get Biomarkers

```{r read_biomarker}
safe_log <- function(data) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(data) ~ NA_real_,
    data <= 0 ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ log(data)
  )
}

bio_df <- haven::read_sas(
  file.path(hrs_dir, "biomarkers", "HCAPbioPilot", "hcapbiopilota_r.sas7bdat")
) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "HHID",
    "PN",
    "PAB42_40_RATIO",
    "PPTAU181",
    "PGFAP",
    "PNFL"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    LOG_AB42_40_RATIO = safe_log(.data$PAB42_40_RATIO),
    LOG_PTAU181 = safe_log(.data$PPTAU181),
    LOG_GFAP = safe_log(.data$PGFAP),
    LOG_NFL = safe_log(.data$PNFL)
  )
```

# Merge

```{r merge}
# Join two tables that each have one row per HHID/PN
join_by_subject <- function(x, y, join = dplyr::left_join) {
  join(
    x,
    y,
    by = c("HHID", "PN"),
    relationship = "one-to-one",
    na_matches = "never"
  )
}

merge_df <- pheno_df %>%
  join_by_subject(dem_df) %>%
  join_by_subject(apoe_df) %>%
  join_by_subject(linkage_df) %>%
  join_by_subject(bio_df)
```

# Save Results

```{r save}
write.csv(
  merge_df,
  file = file.path(data_dir, "phenotype.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
